verdict.rationale: Polar is a payments platform and Merchant of Record, so ML fraud scoring and custom block/review/allow rules are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents checkout, dunning, refunds, payouts, webhooks and MCP, but nothing on fraud scores or fraud rule authoring. The closest items, such as refunds and the sandbox, are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
